SFL Browser is an unofficial app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Sunflower Land or its developers. It is created and maintained by independent community members and fans of the game.

The source code is fully open-source and available for public review on GitHub. No private keys, wallet recovery phrases, or sensitive information are ever requested or stored by this app.

Please always exercise caution and follow best security practices when using any third-party software. Use at your own risk.

SFL Browser is an unofficial companion app for Sunflower Land. Play the game in the built-in browser and let the app watch your farm and notify you when things are ready.

1. Allow notifications when the app asks. Exact alarms and ignoring battery optimisation are optional. You can change them later in Settings.
2. Choose “Go to settings” when prompted, or open Settings → Farm & Sync anytime.
3. Enter your Farm ID (shown in-game at the top of the options panel: Settings → 3 dots).
4. Enter your API key (in-game: Settings → 3 dots → General → API Key). It stays encrypted on your device.
5. Tap “Run a check now” to confirm everything works.

On the Notifications tab, choose which categories alert you. Feeding alerts are separate for chickens, cows, sheep, and pigs. Cooking buildings, the Crafting Box, and the Crop Machine can alert for each item or once when the queue is done. The Crop Machine can also alert when it runs out of oil with unfinished packs. Set an offset for completion alerts and a grouping window for same-named items.

On the Notifications tab, grant the exact alarm permission and the battery exemption so alerts arrive on time. Battery saving mode skips exact alarms and delivers alerts on the next scheduled check instead.

Full browser mode opens the game, with sfl.world and the SFL Wiki available as additional tabs on fresh installs. Manage home tabs on the Browser page in Settings and tap the stacked-tabs icon to switch between them. To reload the page, open the menu (☰) and choose Refresh.

Under Settings → Browser → Appearance, open Customize browser layout to move controls between top and bottom rows, resize them, or tuck them into Hidden. If you hide Settings as well, long-press the app icon to get back to it. Color theme previews the native app colors without changing websites. In Settings, swipe sideways to switch pages. You can hide the browser controls and Android navigation buttons independently.

Turn on Notifications only on the Browser page to disable the built-in browser. The app icon then opens Settings, and tapping an alert opens Settings or an app you select. Long-press the app icon for Overview, Timeline, and Settings shortcuts.

From the menu (☰), Overview groups your farm by section and Timeline lists what finishes next, including the daily UTC reset. Available Telegram quests and Bud Boxes appear at the top until completed. Tap a building name to expand its queue, a grouped row’s arrow to see its timers, or a raffle start’s arrow to see all the prizes. The app reuses its saved timers when the farm hasn’t changed and recalculates when a time-based change affects them.

On the Price Alerts tab, add alerts for collectibles, wearables, Buds, and Pets to be notified when an item lists at or below — or at or above — your target price. Batched price checks use a marketplace snapshot that updates about once a minute. Turn this off to look up live prices one item at a time.
For support, questions, or bug reports, visit the SFL Browser channel on the official Sunflower Land Discord, or the project’s GitHub page.
